metadata.source: Auditor General reports, Parliamentary Budget Office, Parliamentary Committees, CBC/Globe investigations

anomalies.name: Phoenix Pay System
anomalies.detail: Pay system replacement that left 150,000+ public servants with incorrect pay. Stabilization alone cost $2.2B. Total lifecycle cost estimated at $7.5B+.

anomalies.name: ArriveCAN App
anomalies.detail: COVID border app. Two-person company GC Strategies received $19.1M as middleman. RCMP charged two individuals with fraud. CBSA failed basic contract management.

rcmp_update.employees: Two-person company — neither performs IT work, subcontracts everything for 15-30% fee
rcmp_update.charges_status: Formal fraud charges pending as of latest reports

anomalies.name: Trans Mountain Pipeline
anomalies.detail: Government purchased pipeline for $4.5B, expansion ballooned to $34.2B. Sold at a loss. PBO found costs exceeded economic benefits.

anomalies.name: Canadian Surface Combatants (Type 26)
anomalies.detail: 15 frigates. Original budget $26.2B, PBO estimate now $84B. Design not finalized. First ship delivery delayed to 2030s. Single-source to Irving.

anomalies.name: F-35 Fighter Jets
anomalies.detail: AG found DND understated lifecycle costs by $10B+. Program cancelled, re-competed, then awarded to same vendor (Lockheed F-35) at higher price.

anomalies.name: Site C Dam
anomalies.detail: Hydroelectric dam. Cost escalated from $6.6B to $16B. Geotechnical issues. Indigenous rights concerns. Power not needed for decades.

anomalies.name: SDTC Green Slush Fund
anomalies.detail: SDTC board members awarded $390M+ to companies they had financial interests in. AG found 186 separate conflicts of interest. $400M to their own companies. RCMP investigating. Ethics Commissioner found 90 violations.

ag_findings.detail: AG found 186 separate conflicts of interest. Liberal insiders appointed to run program gave $400M in taxpayer money to their own companies. RCMP investigating.

anomalies.name: McKinsey Consulting
anomalies.detail: McKinsey received $209M in federal contracts. Sole-sourced across 23+ departments. Senate investigation found no competitive process for most contracts.

ag_findings.non_competitive_failure: 18 of 19 contracts lacked required justification for non-competitive process
ag_findings.departments_non_compliant: 9 of 10 departments failed to follow procurement policies
ag_findings.revolving_door: Dominic Barton: McKinsey Managing Director → Canada Ambassador to China → Liberal economic advisory chair

anomalies.name: Sponsorship Scandal
anomalies.detail: $332M sponsorship program. $100M+ to Liberal-connected ad firms for little or no work. Multiple criminal convictions. Led to Federal Accountability Act.

anomalies.name: Curam Benefits System
anomalies.detail: Benefits delivery modernization. Estimated $5B+ total cost. Officials testified they 'don't know' the final cost. 15+ years in development.

anomalies.name: Ontario PPE Procurement
anomalies.detail: COVID PPE purchased at up to 26x market price. Sole-sourced to retail chains. Ontario AG found $4.4B in pandemic spending lacked proper oversight.

anomalies.name: Shared Services Canada Data Centres
anomalies.detail: IT consolidation of 63 email systems, 485 data centres. Years behind schedule. Security vulnerabilities. Cost doubled.

anomalies.name: Long-Gun Registry
anomalies.detail: Originally budgeted at $2M net cost. Final cost exceeded $2B. AG found 'ichotic' lack of oversight. Eventually scrapped in 2012.

anomalies.name: HMCS Chicoutimi Submarine
anomalies.detail: 4 used UK submarines purchased for $750M. One caught fire on delivery voyage, killing Lt. Chris Saunders. Refits cost $3.4B+. Still plagued with problems.

anomalies.name: eHealth Ontario
anomalies.detail: Electronic health records system. $1B spent with little to show. Consultants billed $3,000/day. CEO expensed $5M in untendered contracts to consultants.

anomalies.name: Bombardier CSeries Bailout
anomalies.detail: $4B+ in federal/provincial subsidies. Program sold to Airbus for $1. Quebec taxpayers lost entire investment. Executives collected $32.5M in bonuses during bailout.

anomalies.name: SNC-Lavalin Deferred Prosecution
anomalies.detail: PMO pressured AG to grant deferred prosecution for fraud/bribery charges. PM found to have violated Conflict of Interest Act. SNC-Lavalin convicted of fraud.

anomalies.name: WE Charity Scandal
anomalies.detail: $912M student grant program sole-sourced to WE Charity. PM and Finance Minister had financial ties to WE. Both found in violation of ethics rules. Program cancelled.
